in_marathi.name: Ajin
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ajin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘aj’ meaning ‘not’ and ‘jin’ meaning ‘conqueror’, Ajin is a name that signifies the one who is invincible and immune to death.
